description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git revision traversal behavior, particularly with grafts and path limitations. It sets up test repositories, manipulates commit history, and verifies traversal outputs under different configurations.

methods.name: check
methods.description: A function to run 'git rev-list' with specified options and compare the output against expected results, depending on the test type ('basic', 'parents', or 'parents-raw').
